maddeler.e:
أضطبن (form VIII)
# أَضْطَبِنُ (ʔaḍṭabinu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.bi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# أُضْطَبَنُ (ʔuḍṭabanu) /ʔudˤ.tˤa.ba.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# أَضْطَبِنَ (ʔaḍṭabina) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.bi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# أُضْطَبَنَ (ʔuḍṭabana) /ʔud
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
